items.q: All right. So I go with Danny Love(?). We go to Baltimore and we play a couple of towns.

ctx.x: So that was at that period. Now, that's the late period. That's in the Sixties, before I come down here.

All right. So I go with Danny Love(?). We go to Baltimore and we play a couple of towns. Then I go down south with Billy Fowler's band, which is a band. We get stranded in North Carolina, and I'm around there. We stayed around there about four or five weeks, a little longer. We went there anticipating that somebody is going to book us around there.
